verdict.rationale: Riskified documents a REST API, but nothing in the evidence offers a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. Probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. The llms.txt and .md documentation pages are machine-readable prose, which is an adjacent feature and not an API specification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
